title: Kilimanjaro Mountain Guides: Training and Certification
excerpt: Who guides you on Kilimanjaro? How mountain guides are licensed and trained in first aid and altitude safety.
body:
## Licence

Kilimanjaro guides must be licensed by Kilimanjaro National Park.

## Experience

Most guides start as porters, then become assistant guides, and finally lead guides.

## First aid

Good guides have first aid and wilderness medical training, and know how to recognise altitude illness.

## Equipment

Oximeters, first aid kits and emergency oxygen.

## Our partner

The guides of Kilimanjaro Nature Tours check climbers twice a day. See [safety on Kilimanjaro](/blog/safety-on-kilimanjaro/).
